interface_deviations.deviation: Reason codes are a closed set defined in vocabulary.py. Three codes appear that INTERFACES.md section 3 does not name explicitly: IN_DOCUMENT_QA_RANGE (child-route reason), CHILD_RANGE_NOT_READ and LOW_INFORMATION.
interface_deviations.impact: INTERFACES.md fixes the reason *shape* {code, unit_ids, detail} but does not freeze the code vocabulary, so this is additive. ROOT should treat unknown codes as informational.

interface_deviations.deviation: Raises KeyError for an unknown profile id and TypeError/ValueError for a malformed one, instead of returning a fallback profile.
interface_deviations.impact: Deliberate: inventing a profile would hide a real wiring mistake. Callers must handle KeyError.

real_defects_found_and_fixed_by_c_node: SPEAKER_TURN matched statement-footnote labels Notes:/Note: (33 occurrences in the real 246-page HK annual report), routing a genuine annual report to earnings_call. Fixed with is_speaker_turn() and the closed NON_SPEAKER_LABELS set.
A cross-regime QA/transcript candidate could outrank a regime-specific periodic candidate (_call_candidate 76 > _hk_candidate 70). Fixed with _regime_is_structural().

An SEC form label inside running prose ('...the risk factor section of our Form 10-K' on the real MSFT earnings call) was read as the document's own cover label, routing a transcript to annual. Fixed by requiring title evidence or real SEC item structure.

A 《募集资金管理办法》 heading cited inside a prospectus was read as that prospectus's own administrative purpose, routing a 429-page IPO prospectus to administrative. Fixed by separating the supplied-title channel from the in-body heading channel.

A bare 声明 section (mandatory front matter of every A-share report, and 发行人声明/特别提示 in offering documents) was read as an administrative purpose. Removed from the administrative vocabulary; 声明 is disclosure boilerplate, not a document purpose.
The plain English phrase 'annual report' fired the HK annual signal on a US filing. HK signals now require HK section vocabulary or a bilingual heading.

Traditional 中期報告 was missed because NFKC does not fold Traditional Chinese to Simplified, so a real HK interim report routed to the annual family. Both spellings are now listed explicitly, with a comment recording why NFKC is not sufficient.

Bare form names in prose were trusted, so a 10-Q's own 'our annual report on Form 10-K' sentence reclassified it as a 10-K. A form name now only counts from a printed form label or a cover line, never from a pointer to another filing.

An offering whose only offering evidence was a later fundraising unit (front matter alone in the probed window) fell into the periodic family. Fundraising structure now identifies an offering, while a real periodic report that names itself keeps its family.
